title: Iron Woods: the power and charisma of a dry stout
description: Enjoy the noble taste of Iron Woods, in which six types of malt create a unique composition of aromas and flavors.

blocks.html:
The taste of this dark beer is infused with strength and character. Even its name evokes the untamed spirit of the wild forest and the charisma of freedom. The secret to Iron Woods Stout lies in its noble recipe, masterfully blending six specialty malts. This bold combination fills the aroma with notes of caramel, roasted coffee, and spices, finishing with a delicate herbal hop scent. And the foam? It's worth special mention—creamy, dense, and incredibly flavorful, cascading proudly in your glass like a frothy avalanche.

Iron Woods isn’t just another dry stout; it’s the embodiment of freedom and untamed nature in every sip. Using six distinct specialty malts, we’ve crafted a beer with a unique and complex flavor. Each note of caramel, roasted coffee, and spices, accentuated by a subtle herbal hop aroma, makes Iron Woods a true work of art.

This stout is the perfect choice for those who appreciate intricate flavors and aromas. It pairs beautifully with a variety of dishes, from savory to sweet. Whether you’re enjoying Iron Woods on your own or with friends, it’s sure to leave a lasting impression.

Iron Woods is a dessert beer, an excellent companion to oysters, barbecue, cheeses, as well as fruit pies and chocolate cakes. Its distinguished flavor complements any dish, and when ordered on its own, it performs as a powerful solo act for an unforgettable beer evening.

The Dry Stout, also known as the Irish Stout, boasts a rich and captivating history. Emerging in the early 18th century, it has become an integral part of global beer culture. What sets a Dry Stout apart is its roasted flavor, achieved through the use of roasted barley. This style is characterized by its low residual sugar content, making it less sweet compared to other dark ales. Its aroma and flavor often feature notes of coffee, chocolate, and caramel, giving it remarkable depth and complexity.

Dry Stouts typically have medium to low carbonation, offering a smooth and easy-drinking experience. Their appearance ranges from deep brown to black, topped with a creamy, lasting head. This beer style pairs wonderfully with a variety of foods, including seafood, cheeses, and desserts, making it a versatile and sophisticated choice for any occasion.
